raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Jimmy stole from me and blocked my Brick 6. He's using my own words ('just a game of numbers') against me to justify his move to Gemma. I have 1 Wheat, 1 Ore, and 1 Sheep left. I need to keep my cool to avoid further isolation, but I should remind them that Jimmy is actually the one with the most resources right now.","note_to_self":"Jimmy blocked my Brick 6 and stole a card.
